objects.title: Cell state and perturbation encoding
objects.summary: Encode molecular profiles, cell states, perturbations, time, and context at the relevant biological unit.
objects.summaryZh: 在相关生物单位上编码分子谱、细胞状态、扰动、时间和语境。

objects.title: Chemical series feedback
objects.summary: Use analogue series and experimental feedback to revise a discovery hypothesis.
objects.summaryZh: 使用类似物系列和实验反馈修订药物发现假设。

objects.title: Chemical standardization
objects.summary: Freeze salt, charge, tautomer, stereochemistry, duplicate, mixture, and identifier rules for a dataset.
objects.summaryZh: 为数据集冻结盐型、电荷、互变异构、立体化学、重复、混合物和标识符规则。

objects.title: Chemoselectivity and protecting groups
objects.summary: Identify chemoselectivity and protecting-group constraints that a retrosynthetic graph can hide.
objects.summaryZh: 识别逆合成图可能隐藏的化学选择性和保护基约束。

objects.title: Clearance exposure and PK PD
objects.titleZh: 清除率、暴露与 PK PD
objects.summary: Relate clearance, concentration time profiles, pharmacodynamics, and translational assumptions.
objects.summaryZh: 关联清除率、浓度时间曲线、药效学和转化假设。

objects.title: Cofolding state hypotheses
objects.summary: Interpret a cofolded complex as one structural hypothesis rather than a direct affinity measurement.
objects.summaryZh: 将共折叠复合物解读为一种结构假设，而非直接亲和力测量。

objects.title: Colocalization and Mendelian randomization
objects.titleZh: 共定位与孟德尔随机化
objects.summary: Compare shared-signal and instrumental-variable assumptions when prioritizing a target.
objects.summaryZh: 在靶点优先级排序时比较共享信号和工具变量假设。

objects.title: Comparison reading practice
objects.summary: Read a completed comparison while identifying its inputs, claim boundary, and remaining uncertainty.
objects.summaryZh: 阅读一个已完成的比较，同时识别其输入、主张边界和剩余不确定性。

objects.title: Complex contact and pose graphs
objects.summary: Represent complexes, interfaces, contacts, and poses without collapsing distinct physical states.
objects.summaryZh: 表示复合物、界面、接触和构象，而不合并不同物理状态。

objects.title: Convergence and replica diagnostics
objects.summary: Diagnose convergence, replica agreement, and sensitivity before interpreting a physical estimate.
objects.summaryZh: 在解读物理估计前诊断收敛、重复一致性和敏感性。

objects.title: Counterevidence led failure analysis
objects.titleZh: 由反证驱动的失败分析
objects.summary: Preserve counterevidence and diagnose failure modes before promoting a candidate claim.
objects.summaryZh: 在提升候选项主张前保留反证并诊断失败模式。

objects.title: CRISPR and Perturb-seq
objects.summary: Define perturbation, cell, donor, and context units when interpreting genetic perturbation responses.
objects.summaryZh: 在解读遗传扰动响应时定义扰动、细胞、供体和语境单位。

objects.title: Cross-domain tradeoffs
objects.summary: Compare efficacy, safety, exposure, synthetic feasibility, and evidence gaps against the product profile.
objects.summaryZh: 根据产品概况比较疗效、安全性、暴露、合成可行性和证据缺口。

objects.title: Data contract assembly
objects.summary: Declare producer, version, entities, labels, exclusions, inference unit, split, and expected output.
objects.summaryZh: 声明生产者、版本、实体、标签、排除、推断单位、划分与预期输出。

objects.title: Design objective and constraints
objects.summary: Write an explicit design objective with property, novelty, synthesis, safety, and experimental constraints.
objects.summaryZh: 写出包含性质、新颖性、合成、安全和实验约束的明确设计目标。

objects.title: Developability and manufacturability
objects.summary: Evaluate expression, stability, aggregation, formulation, and manufacturing constraints alongside functional design.
objects.summaryZh: 将表达、稳定性、聚集、制剂和制造约束与功能设计一同评估。

objects.title: Diffusion generation
objects.summary: Explain iterative denoising and conditional generation without treating a generated sample as validated.
objects.summaryZh: 解释迭代去噪和条件生成，而不将生成样本视为已验证。

objects.title: DMTA decision loop
objects.summary: Define the design make test analyze loop, its evidence inputs, and its next experimental decision.
objects.summaryZh: 定义设计、制备、测试、分析循环及其证据输入和下一项实验决策。

objects.title: Docking score and rescoring
objects.summary: Separate pose generation, scoring, rescoring, and experimental binding evidence.
objects.summaryZh: 区分构象生成、打分、重打分和实验结合证据。

objects.title: Dose response and assay windows
objects.summary: Interpret response ranges, controls, and assay windows without treating a single readout as mechanism proof.
objects.summaryZh: 解读反应范围、对照和测定窗口，而不将单一读出视为机制证明。

objects.title: Endpoint and loss design
objects.summary: Translate a scientific endpoint into model inputs, targets, losses, and mismatch risks.
objects.summaryZh: 将科学终点转化为模型输入、目标、损失与失配风险。

objects.title: Entity resolution workflow
objects.summary: Resolve chemical, protein, assay, disease, and sample identifiers while retaining ambiguity.
objects.summaryZh: 解析化学、蛋白、测定、疾病和样本标识符，同时保留歧义。

objects.title: Entity vocabulary and identity
objects.summary: Distinguish molecules, compounds, assays, targets, complexes, cell states, patients, and candidates.
objects.summaryZh: 区分分子、化合物、测定、靶点、复合物、细胞状态、患者与候选项。

objects.title: Evidence claim boundaries
objects.summary: Separate direct observations from inferences and unresolved unknowns in an AIDD question.
objects.summaryZh: 在 AIDD 问题中区分直接观察、推断与未解决的未知。

objects.title: Evidence package assembly
objects.summary: Assemble target, screening, ADMET, and evaluation evidence while retaining conflicts and unknowns.
objects.summaryZh: 组装靶点、筛选、ADMET 和评估证据，同时保留冲突和未知。

objects.title: Execution trace and state recovery
objects.summary: Inspect a tool trace to recover inputs, outputs, state changes, and unobserved failures.
objects.summaryZh: 检查工具轨迹以恢复输入、输出、状态变化和未观察到的失败。

objects.title: Experiment pools and budgeting
objects.summary: Construct a feasible experiment pool with budget, capacity, timing, and exclusion constraints.
objects.summaryZh: 构建具有预算、容量、时间和排除约束的可行实验池。

objects.title: Exposure and endpoint contract
objects.summary: Define an exposure endpoint, route, sampling context, and decision use before interpreting a prediction.
objects.summaryZh: 在解读预测前定义暴露终点、给药途径、采样语境和决策用途。

objects.title: Fitting selection and error sandbox
objects.summary: Run a synthetic teaching example that keeps validation choice separate from final holdout interpretation.
objects.summaryZh: 运行一个合成教学示例，将验证集选择与最终留出集解释保持分离。

objects.title: Flow matching
objects.summary: Explain flow matching as velocity learning over a path between distributions without implying a complete design workflow.
objects.summaryZh: 将流匹配解释为分布路径上的速度学习，而不暗示其构成完整设计工作流。

objects.title: Force fields and solvent
objects.summary: Explain how force-field choice and solvent treatment define a model rather than a universal physical truth.
objects.summaryZh: 解释力场选择和溶剂处理如何定义一个模型，而非普遍物理真相。

objects.title: Forward reaction and lab feedback
objects.summary: Compare predicted reaction conditions with laboratory observations and use failures to revise a route.
objects.summaryZh: 将预测反应条件与实验室观察比较，并利用失败修订路线。

objects.title: Functional validation design
objects.summary: Plan functional validation that distinguishes intended activity, context dependence, and safety-relevant alternatives.
objects.summaryZh: 规划可区分预期活性、语境依赖性和安全相关替代解释的功能验证。

objects.title: Gaussian processes
objects.summary: Use a Gaussian-process view to relate kernel assumptions, interpolation, and predictive uncertainty.
objects.summaryZh: 使用高斯过程视角关联核假设、插值与预测不确定性。

objects.title: Generalization unit and estimand
objects.summary: Define the independent unit and target population to which a result is intended to generalize.
objects.summaryZh: 定义结果意图泛化到的独立单位和目标人群。

objects.title: Geometric equivariance
objects.summary: Match rotational and translational symmetry assumptions to a molecular geometry task.
objects.summaryZh: 将旋转和平移对称性假设与分子几何任务相匹配。

objects.title: GNN message passing
objects.summary: Explain how node and edge messages aggregate local graph information and what they cannot identify.
objects.summaryZh: 解释节点与边消息如何聚合局部图信息，以及其无法识别的内容。

objects.title: Governance and dual-use boundaries
objects.summary: Identify openness, biosecurity, governance, and authority boundaries that require scoped human review.
objects.summaryZh: 识别需要范围化人工审查的开放性、生物安全、治理和权限边界。

objects.title: GWAS fine mapping
objects.summary: Distinguish an associated locus from a credible causal variant set and its assumptions.
objects.summaryZh: 区分关联位点与可信因果变异集合及其假设。

objects.title: Knowledge graph schema and evidence
objects.summary: Model typed entities, relations, evidence provenance, and missing edges without equating connectivity with causality.
objects.summaryZh: 建模带类型的实体、关系、证据来源和缺失边，而不将连通性等同于因果性。

objects.title: Licence and permitted use
objects.summary: Separate data access from licence, redistribution, commercial use, privacy, consent, and unresolved fields.
objects.summaryZh: 将数据访问与许可证、再分发、商业用途、隐私、同意和未解决字段区分开来。

objects.title: Mechanism hypothesis and counterevidence
objects.summary: Connect a disease mechanism to supporting evidence, alternatives, and a falsifying observation.
objects.summaryZh: 将疾病机制与支持证据、替代解释和可证伪观察连接起来。

objects.title: Metabolism and DDI mechanisms
objects.summary: Distinguish metabolism hypotheses, enzyme context, and drug drug interaction risk from a generic score.
objects.summaryZh: 将代谢假设、酶语境和药物相互作用风险与通用评分区分开来。

objects.title: Metric estimand and uncertainty
objects.titleZh: 指标估计量与不确定性
objects.summary: Match a metric and uncertainty interval to the endpoint, independent unit, and decision.
objects.summaryZh: 将指标和不确定性区间与终点、独立单位和决策相匹配。

objects.title: Modality and construct selection
objects.summary: Match protein, peptide, antibody, nucleic-acid, conjugate, or degrader choices to a therapeutic hypothesis.
objects.summaryZh: 将蛋白、多肽、抗体、核酸、偶联物或降解剂选择与治疗假设相匹配。

objects.title: Model table construction
objects.summary: Transform aligned records into a model table with an explicit row unit and retained exclusions.
objects.summaryZh: 将对齐记录转换为建模表，并明确行单位和保留的排除项。

objects.title: Molecular dynamics and sampling
objects.summary: Relate trajectories, sampling limits, observables, and correlated frames to a dynamical claim.
objects.summaryZh: 将轨迹、采样限制、观测量和相关帧与动态主张关联起来。

objects.title: Molecular representation choice
objects.summary: Compare line notations, descriptors, fingerprints, graphs, and conformers by the chemical information they retain.
objects.summaryZh: 按保留的化学信息比较线性符号、描述符、指纹、图和构象。

objects.title: Multi-parameter ADMET optimization
objects.summary: Compare efficacy, exposure, metabolism, and safety tradeoffs without reducing them to one score.
objects.summaryZh: 比较疗效、暴露、代谢和安全性权衡，而不将其缩减为一个分数。

objects.title: Multiobjective search and diversity
objects.summary: Allocate search effort across objectives and diversity without silently changing the selection rule.
objects.summaryZh: 在不暗中改变选择规则的情况下，在多个目标和多样性之间分配搜索资源。

objects.title: Next experiment design
objects.summary: Specify the next experiment, its control, expected decision update, and observation that would change course.
objects.summaryZh: 明确下一项实验、其对照、预期决策更新和会改变方向的观察。

objects.title: Nomination readiness
objects.summary: Decide whether a candidate is ready for a bounded next experiment and state the evidence gap.
objects.summaryZh: 判断候选项是否准备好进入受限的下一项实验，并说明证据缺口。

objects.title: Normalizing flows
objects.summary: Explain invertible transformations and density change terms before using a flow-based design model.
objects.summaryZh: 在使用基于流的设计模型前解释可逆变换和密度变化项。

objects.title: Nucleic acid therapeutics
objects.summary: Relate nucleic-acid modality, target biology, delivery, and off-target risks to a validation plan.
objects.summaryZh: 将核酸模态、靶点生物学、递送和脱靶风险与验证计划关联起来。

objects.title: OOD shift and transportability
objects.titleZh: 分布外变化与可迁移性
objects.summary: Specify the distribution shift and assumptions required to transport a result beyond observed data.
objects.summaryZh: 明确将结果迁移到观察数据之外所需的分布变化和假设。

objects.title: Open structural assets and reuse
objects.summary: Check model, weights, code, input, output, and licence availability before claiming a workflow is reproducible.
objects.summaryZh: 在声称工作流可复现前检查模型、权重、代码、输入、输出和许可证的可用性。

objects.title: Peptide design
objects.summary: Define peptide sequence and conformational objectives together with stability and delivery constraints.
objects.summaryZh: 将多肽序列和构象目标与稳定性和递送约束共同定义。

objects.title: Perturbation context generalization
objects.summary: Test whether a perturbation prediction transports across cell contexts without interpreting transfer as validation.
objects.summaryZh: 检验扰动预测能否跨细胞语境迁移，而不将迁移解释为验证。

objects.title: Phenotype context definition
objects.summary: Define indication, phenotype, tissue, cell state, population, and temporal context for a target question.
objects.summaryZh: 为靶点问题定义适应症、表型、组织、细胞状态、人群和时间语境。

objects.title: Pocket definition and cryptic sites
objects.summary: Define a binding site boundary and distinguish observed pockets from hypothesized cryptic sites.
objects.summaryZh: 定义结合位点边界，并区分观察到的口袋与假设的隐蔽位点。

objects.title: Pose affinity and binder separation
objects.titleZh: 构象、亲和力与结合体判定分离
objects.summary: Separate coordinate confidence, binder probability, and affinity prediction from causal energetic proof.
objects.summaryZh: 将坐标置信度、结合体概率和亲和力预测与因果能量证明分开。

objects.title: Property endpoint contract
objects.summary: Specify property, assay, unit, censoring, aggregation, and prediction unit before fitting a model.
objects.summaryZh: 在拟合模型前明确性质、测定、单位、删失、聚合和预测单位。

objects.title: Protein sequence and structure encoding
objects.summary: Relate sequence, alignment, residue, geometry, surface, and ensemble encodings to a protein question.
objects.summaryZh: 将序列、比对、残基、几何、表面和集合编码与蛋白问题关联起来。

objects.title: Provenance lineage
objects.summary: Trace records and transformations to a dated source release and processing stage.
objects.summaryZh: 将记录和转换追溯到带日期的来源版本和处理阶段。

objects.title: QM MM boundaries
objects.summary: Choose a quantum and molecular-mechanics boundary that matches the chemical event and state the approximation.
objects.summaryZh: 选择与化学事件相匹配的量子与分子力学边界，并说明该近似。

objects.title: Ranking and decision thresholds
objects.summary: Relate calibrated predictions and uncertainty to a screening or follow-up decision threshold.
objects.summaryZh: 将校准预测和不确定性与筛选或后续实验的决策阈值关联起来。

objects.title: Reaction record and condition contract
objects.summary: Define reactants, products, conditions, yields, provenance, and missing fields for a reaction record.
objects.summaryZh: 为反应记录定义反应物、产物、条件、产率、来源和缺失字段。

objects.title: Record normalization and exclusion
objects.summary: Define duplicate, normalization, censoring, missingness, conflict, and exclusion rules before modelling.
objects.summaryZh: 在建模前定义重复、标准化、删失、缺失、冲突和排除规则。

objects.title: Regression and classification errors
objects.summary: Compare residuals, thresholds, label noise, and error costs before converting an endpoint into a task.
objects.summaryZh: 在将终点转化为任务前比较残差、阈值、标签噪声和误差代价。

objects.title: Relative and absolute binding free energy
objects.titleZh: 相对与绝对结合自由能
objects.summary: Distinguish alchemical relative and absolute free-energy endpoints, their networks, and their assumptions.
objects.summaryZh: 区分炼金相对与绝对自由能终点、其网络及其假设。

objects.title: Representation loss and invariance
objects.summary: Identify information lost by an encoding and state which transformations should leave a prediction unchanged.
objects.summaryZh: 识别编码丢失的信息，并说明哪些变换应使预测保持不变。

objects.title: Representation selection for properties
objects.summary: Select representations from the endpoint, data regime, and information that must be retained.
objects.summaryZh: 根据终点、数据规模和必须保留的信息选择表示。

objects.title: Reproduction scope and limitations
objects.summary: State the inputs, protocol scope, observed outputs, and limitations of a reproduction attempt.
objects.summaryZh: 陈述复现尝试的输入、协议范围、观察到的输出和局限。

objects.title: Retrieval augmented generation
objects.summary: Separate retrieved context, source scope, and model generation from a verified scientific conclusion.
objects.summaryZh: 将检索语境、来源范围和模型生成与已验证科学结论区分开来。

objects.title: Retrosynthetic disconnection
objects.summary: Propose and compare disconnections while preserving route assumptions and unavailable precursors.
objects.summaryZh: 提出并比较断键策略，同时保留路线假设和不可得前体。

objects.title: Ridge fitting and validation selection
objects.titleZh: 岭回归拟合与验证集选择
objects.summary: Fit a Ridge baseline, choose regularization on validation data, and reserve final holdout results for interpretation.
objects.summaryZh: 拟合岭回归基线，在验证数据上选择正则化，并将最终留出集结果保留给解释。

objects.title: Route feasibility material and safety
objects.titleZh: 路线可行性、原料与安全
objects.summary: Assess material availability, route length, safety, and operational constraints before selecting a synthesis plan.
objects.summaryZh: 在选择合成计划前评估原料可得性、路线长度、安全性和操作约束。

objects.title: SAR explanations and counterfactuals
objects.titleZh: 构效关系解释与反事实
objects.summary: Form a bounded structure activity explanation and state the analogue evidence that could challenge it.
objects.summaryZh: 形成有边界的构效关系解释，并说明可挑战它的类似物证据。

objects.title: Scaffold time and group splits
objects.summary: Choose a split that matches the intended prospective, scaffold, group, or time generalization claim.
objects.summaryZh: 选择与预期前瞻、骨架、分组或时间泛化主张相匹配的划分。

objects.title: Scientific computing environments
objects.summary: Identify the data, code, numerical, and compute assumptions needed to reproduce a bounded modelling exercise.
objects.summaryZh: 识别复现受限建模练习所需的数据、代码、数值与计算假设。

objects.title: Scientific task and authority boundaries
objects.summary: Define a bounded scientific task, permitted actions, unresolved decisions, and human authority.
objects.summaryZh: 定义受限科学任务、允许行动、未解决决策和人工权限。

objects.title: Screening unit and assay design
objects.summary: Define target, assay, compound set, control, and screening unit before comparing methods.
objects.summaryZh: 在比较方法前定义靶点、测定、化合物集合、对照和筛选单位。

objects.title: Selection locks and test isolation
objects.titleZh: 选择锁定与测试集隔离
objects.summary: Keep model selection, threshold choices, and test interpretation isolated under a frozen protocol.
objects.summaryZh: 在冻结协议下保持模型选择、阈值选择和测试集解释彼此隔离。

objects.title: Source scope review
objects.summary: State what a reviewed source directly supports and what remains outside its scope.
objects.summaryZh: 说明已审查来源直接支持的内容及其范围之外仍未知的内容。

objects.title: Specificity and negative selection
objects.summary: Design positive and negative selection conditions that test specificity rather than a generic activity score.
objects.summaryZh: 设计检验特异性而非通用活性评分的正向和负向筛选条件。

objects.title: Split construction and leakage audit
objects.summary: Construct and audit splits for entity, time, group, and preprocessing leakage.
objects.summaryZh: 针对实体、时间、分组和预处理泄漏构建并审查数据划分。

objects.title: Stopping rules and policy evaluation
objects.summary: Predeclare stopping rules and evaluate an experiment-selection policy against opportunity cost.
objects.summaryZh: 预先声明停止规则，并根据机会成本评估实验选择策略。

objects.title: Structural confidence and alternatives
objects.titleZh: 结构置信度与替代解释
objects.summary: Compare confidence signals, alternative states, and experimental information that could resolve a structural ambiguity.
objects.summaryZh: 比较置信度信号、替代状态和可解决结构歧义的实验信息。

objects.title: Structure evidence and state
objects.summary: Identify the experimental or predicted structural state and its relevant missing context.
objects.summaryZh: 识别实验或预测结构状态及其相关的缺失语境。

objects.title: System state and boundary conditions
objects.summary: Specify components, protonation, solvent, temperature, restraints, and observables for a physical model.
objects.summaryZh: 为物理模型明确组分、质子化、溶剂、温度、约束和观测量。

objects.title: Target product profile design
objects.summary: Specify population, route, efficacy, safety, exposure, and developability constraints before optimization.
objects.summaryZh: 在优化前明确人群、给药途径、疗效、安全性、暴露与可开发性约束。

objects.title: Target tractability and risk
objects.summary: Assess modality access, selectivity, safety liabilities, and translational uncertainty for a target hypothesis.
objects.summaryZh: 评估靶点假设的模态可及性、选择性、安全负担和转化不确定性。

objects.title: Therapeutic decision framing
objects.summary: Link disease need, intervention hypothesis, modality, evidence, and the next falsifiable decision.
objects.summaryZh: 连接疾病需求、干预假设、模态、证据与下一项可证伪决策。

objects.title: Thermodynamic cycle design
objects.summary: Construct a thermodynamic cycle whose edge definitions support the desired free-energy comparison.
objects.summaryZh: 构建边定义支持所需自由能比较的热力学循环。

objects.title: Time ordered feedback updates
objects.summary: Update a decision state with delayed experimental outcomes without leaking future observations.
objects.summaryZh: 使用延迟实验结果更新决策状态，而不泄漏未来观察。

objects.title: Tool input output contracts
objects.summary: Specify typed inputs, outputs, failure states, and validation rules for a scientific tool call.
objects.summaryZh: 为科学工具调用定义类型化输入、输出、失败状态和验证规则。

objects.title: Tool to experiment boundaries
objects.summary: Distinguish a tool call, a simulated observation, and a wet experiment with its own authority and evidence.
objects.summaryZh: 区分工具调用、模拟观察和具有自身权限与证据的湿实验。

objects.title: Toxicity endpoints and transfer
objects.summary: Match a toxicity endpoint and biological system to the population and exposure context of a decision.
objects.summaryZh: 将毒性终点和生物体系与决策的人群和暴露语境相匹配。
